text: Visitors have noted issues with signage and accessibility, particularly regarding handicap parking and transportation from the lot to the library entrance. Several reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, describing it as poorly executed and detracting from the experience. Some visitors were frustrated by the need to purchase tickets in advance and the resulting wait times to enter. Food options in the café received negative comments, and a few mentioned crowding and visitor flow challenges. Despite these concerns, the building’s architecture and interactive exhibits were frequently mentioned positively.

A few comments touched on food and beverage services, interpretation, and timed entry, but these were less common. No critical reviews were recorded during this period.
